sentences.en: Juha and his friend sat looking at the moon.

sentences.ar: صاحبه سأل: شو بيصير بالقمر القديم؟
sentences.en: His friend asked: what happens to the old moon?

sentences.ar: قال جحا: بيكسروه ويعملوا منه نجوم.
sentences.en: Juha said: they break it and make stars out of it.
